Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:100011
Court No. - 68
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 20446 of 2024
Applicant :- Meera Devi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Satendra Kumar Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.82 of 2024, under
Sections 498A, 304B, 315 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Sindhauli, District-
Shahjahanpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is mother-in-law of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with son of applicant has taken place on 09.06.2023.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including applicant.
No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.

It was submitted that deceased was Meera Devi vs State Of U.P. on 31 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111926537/
1 pregnant and she has developed some complications and she was taken to the hospital but she died due to pregnancy related complications, as her uterus got ruptured.

entities.text: Meera Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In postmortem report, no injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death is due to rupture of uterus.

It was pointed out that even in the First Information Report, the allegation against applicant and co-accused persons is that deceased was not provided proper treatment but the said allegation is false.
The deceased was provided proper required treatment.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is a lady and she is languishing in jail since 15.03.2024, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Meera Devi involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii.
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.

8. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 31.5.2024 SP/-
